title: 3단계 집 시스템의 연기 이유.....
bodyHtml:
Hello everyone.
I have some news that I know some of you will be disappointed by, but that I also hope makes good sense to most of you. We have chosen to delay housing Phase III until after the holiday in order to make sure that we can provide the best possible customer service when it is released. Everything is ready to go, but in our experience, any changes regarding the way housing works will generate a large number of calls and gm requests.

We know that many of you are waiting anxiously for phase 3 to start, and it is because this is such an important matter that I believe it would be a poor choice on our part to launch it over the holiday.

If we were to release it today, the changes would hit in the middle to the end of next week, just as the holiday for our customer support staff is beginning. In addition, it’s probably unfair to make these changes when people are not in their normal play schedule because of the break.

Now if I can just keep MrTact from vandalizing my office for this change in plans…

--
SunSword
Producer, Ultima Online

간략하게 해석하면

많은 분들이 3단계 시스템을 기다리고 있는 것을 알지만 그것이 휴일과 겹치기 때문에 휴일 다음주 중에 3단계 시스템을 시작한다네요.

(영어가 약해서...ㅜㅜ 번역이 쉬원찮았습니다...ㅜㅜ)

아이~! 이뻐라~!
